basic_info.main_problem: I am distressed by negative thoughts arising from my favorite rugby team's recent losses, leading me to believe the whole season is ruined.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts have affected my ability to enjoy activities such as watching football matches.

core_beliefs: 事情要么完美，要么一without是处

special_situations.event: Favorite team lost last week's game
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one match is lost, it means the whole season is doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to distract oneself with other hobbies and activities, but avoiding discussing this matter with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 整个赛季都毁了，他们以后也赢not了其他比赛

special_situations.event: 在随后的比赛开始前或观看时（尚not yet有结果）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they might lose this game, it means they will also lose the following games
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses only on negative details when watching, to confirm worries
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这场多半又会很糟，季后赛not希望

special_situations.event: Post-game review after the team loses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 失败说明积极因素都not重要或not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视团队配合与进步，只反复关注失误与not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些好的表现都not值一提，输就是全盘negate

special_situations.event: When thinking about sharing one's troubles with friends or when friends talk about matches
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express these thoughts, friends will think I am exaggerating and judge me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing competitions and feelings with friends, staying silent to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我太戏剧化，not会理解我

core_conflict.wish: 渴望确定性与完美的结果（赛季持续获胜、not被失望）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与not确定带来的失望与失控感
defense_goal: 用非黑即白的规则来简化复杂情境，以降低Anxiety感

object_relations.self_representation: Worries about being seen as an 'overreacting' fan; prone to falling into negativity due to failure
object_relations.object_representation: 朋友被想象为not理解且会评判自己的人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of sharing these negative thoughts with friends or friends mention competitions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认为朋友会觉得自己戏剧化并not理解（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tends to avoid sharing, stays reserved; if a response is needed, uses a tactful, low-intensity tone, expresses briefly, avoiding deeper details.

manifestations: Believing one loss makes the whole season meaningless
Finds it hard to enjoy originally liked activities (reading, watching movies, watching ball games)
outcomes: Reduced investment in competitions and daily activities

manifestations: 有支持性朋友但not分享困扰，担心被认为戏剧化
Relations with family and friends become tense due to negative thinking

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 预设朋友会认为自己夸张而not理解
因此not愿意与朋友讨论负面想法

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Repression向外表达与寻求支持的冲动
选择独自承受并not与朋友沟通

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends
工作与职业功能基本完好（工作表现not yet受影响）
Willing to seek help and try new coping approaches
negative_force: 过度概括与灾难化预测not yet来
Mental filtering, focusing only on negative details
negate正面思考，难以承认积极因素
担心被评判而Avoiding communication with others

target_behavior.behavior: After the team's loss, repeatedly ponders and asserts 'the season is ruined', and avoids discussing with others
antecedent: 新一场比赛开始前的Anticipation情境
target_behavior.core_reason: Understands competition results with a black-and-white cognitive rule, and overgeneralizes one failure into a long-term disaster to seek certainty
target_behavior.function: 通过简化为“全好或全坏”来获得心理上的确定感，避免面对失望与not确定
target_behavior.consequence: 难以享受观看比赛及其他活动；与家人朋友Relationship tension、社交互动受影响
